notes: All 50 complete blinded source reports personally read in five ten-report groups, with all 600 target decisions explicitly reasoned and recorded. No batch045 draft, review, preread or reviewer staging was opened. Reviewer later announced a frozen independent preread without exposing any decisions; this did not alter reader work. No official gold or legacy annotations inspected. Scripts assemble explicit individual decisions and validate exact source quotations, schema, hashes and exact UID membership only; no regex/NLI/default filling or automatic label inference. Two evidence quotations were expanded to include explicit medial anatomy, with unchanged states and a preserved staging log. Source contradictions, malformed text, uncertain anatomy, severity, extent and acuity are preserved. All incomplete work remained outside initiative. This draft requires independent source review; report-derived weak labels are not image diagnostic rereads.
